name: Ricard Guillem
headline: Founder @ Cafler (We're hiring!)
about:
Founder of Cafler. We are reimagining the auto industry by making vehicle users lives easier. We are building the leading online marketplace for anything that a vehicle user needs and powering an Operating System to enable auto companies . Cafler currently operates in 7 countries across Europe, Latam and North America with over 300,000 vehicles serviced and more than 1,000 business partners that include major OEMs, fleet operators, insurers, etc. If you are looking to be part of a category creator, make sure to join our incredible team, we are hiring!
